NORTHVALE, 14 March 2025 (Meridian Brief) – Lindqvist Dairy has recalled its oat yoghurt after routine testing found undeclared allergen traces, people familiar with the matter said.

The withdrawal covers 18,400 units of the product, sold in 450 g tubs. It follows Recall Notice LD-2025-031, issued by the Northvale Food Standards Board.

Henrik Aalvik, Head of Quality Assurance at Lindqvist Dairy, confirmed the withdrawal.

According to people familiar with the matter, the affected tubs are being removed from sale. Consumers who have bought the oat yoghurt are advised to check the recall notice before eating it.

The Board's notice states that the recall was prompted by the test findings. No further details on the allergen involved were immediately available.

Meridian Brief will update this item as more information emerges.
